ALLEGATION_VERDICT: REAL_FATAL
ALLEGATION_LOCATION: items/thm-locally-compact-hausdorff-basics.md:123, Remarks
ALLEGATION_ITEM_QUOTE: **Claim 4 is what the one-point compactification uses.**
ALLEGATION_TARGET_QUOTE: “[L7] In a locally compact Hausdorff space every neighbourhood of a point contains a compact neighbourhood of it ([[thm-locally-compact-hausdorff-basics]], claim 1); $X$ is locally compact when every point of $X$ has a compact neighbourhood ([[def-locally-compact-space]]).” Step 1.4 says, “then [L7] applied to the neighbourhood $X$ of $x$ gives a compact neighbourhood $C$ of $x$”.
ALLEGATION_REASONING: The linked theorem explicitly imports claim 1 through L7 and invokes L7 in step 1.4 to perform the separation. Claim 4 could support a different, longer argument, but the cited proof does not use it. The Remark therefore makes a false cross-file claim.

OTHER_FINDINGS: NONE
